instruction: Move large block, medium block, and small block to the center table.

source.instruction: Move large block, medium block, and small block to the center table.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the block3, which was at x = +27 (right half of the table); the LEFT arm grasped the block1, which was at x = -23 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.
